title: Relentless Judgment on Israel

questions.question: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he was exalted in Israel, but he incurred guilt through what and died?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:1 (ESV): "but he incurred guilt through Baal and died."

questions.question: They make for themselves metal images, idols skillfully made of their what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:2 (ESV): "idols skillfully made of their silver,"

questions.question: It is said of them, "Those who offer human sacrifice kiss...?"
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:2 (ESV): "Those who offer human sacrifice kiss calves!"

questions.question: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; you know no God but me, and besides me there is no what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:4 (ESV): "and besides me there is no savior."

questions.question: So I will be to them like a lion; like a what will I lurk beside the way?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:7 (ESV): "like a leopard I will lurk beside the way."

questions.question: I will fall upon them like a bear robbed of her what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:8 (ESV): "I will fall upon them like a bear robbed of her cubs;"

questions.question: He destroys you, O Israel, for you are against whom?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:9 (ESV): "He destroys you, O Israel, for you are against me, against your helper."

questions.question: Where is your king now, that he may save you in all your cities? Where are your rulers of whom you said, "Give me a king and princes"?
I gave you a king in my anger, and I took him away in my what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:11 (ESV): "and I took him away in my wrath."

questions.question: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:12 (ESV): "his sin is kept in store."

questions.question: Therefore they shall be like the morning mist or like the dew that goes early away, like the chaff that swirls from the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:3 (ESV): "like the chaff that swirls from the threshing floor,"

questions.question: It was I who knew you in the wilderness, in the land of what?
But when they had grazed, they became full, they were filled, and their heart was lifted up; therefore they did what?
Shall I ransom them from the power of Sheol? Shall I redeem them from Death? O Death, where are your plagues? O Sheol, where is your sting? Compassion is hidden from my eyes.
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:14 (ESV): "Shall I ransom them from the power of Sheol? Shall I redeem them from Death?..."

questions.question: Though he may flourish among his brothers, the east wind, the wind of the Lord, shall come... and his fountain shall dry up. It shall strip his treasury of every precious thing.
questions.explanation: Hosea 13:15 (ESV): "the east wind, the wind of the Lord, shall come..."

key_verse_text: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; you know no God but me, and besides me there is no savior.
